summary: Each rank owns an adjacent floor-partitioned row range and the active timed path calls its launcher once per parsed iteration. The host clone dispatches the selected lane-width specialization and retains an iteration counter/backedge. All five emitted sm_86 variants show CSR/input loads, DFMA work, loop control, and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: Rank-local matrix initialization generates offset-delimited nonzeros for the local rows; spmvGpu traverses each row's offsets with lane-strided entries, accumulates products and writes output; spmvLauncher selects lanes 1/4/8/32/128 from mean length; run parses -i, defines firstRow/rows, and repeats launch in the timed iteration loop.

compiled_evidence.claim: Compiled run dispatches among launchSpmv<1/4/8/32/128> based on average row length, calls the selected launch for setup, then inside the timed section calls it per iteration and branches back until the requested count is reached.
